title: Visual Project Map — Folder Structure
description: Folder-centric view of the Visual Project Map tool. The collapsed view shows actual directories: spec/ holds requirements, docs/plans/ records design decisions, skills/visualize-project/ generates graph JSON via AI, skills/visualize-plan/ overlays plans onto graphs, and viewer/ renders them as interactive DAGs. Data flows from specifications through design documents and generation to browser rendering.

modules.label: Repository Root
modules.description: Top-level repository containing project specifications, documentation (SPEC.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md), and the plugin directory.

modules.label: spec/
modules.description: Feature catalog (features.md), graph invariant properties (graph-properties.md), and proposed features. Also includes SPEC.md at the repo root defining the action model (describe, initialize, refactor, plan), folder premise, and design principles.

inputs.name: product_vision
inputs.description: High-level objectives, action model, and design principles

outputs.name: requirements
outputs.description: Feature specs (F01–F79), graph invariants, and structural constraints

modules.label: Project Config
modules.description: Plugin marketplace manifest (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json), plugin manifest (plugins/.../.claude-plugin/plugin.json), and GitHub CI configuration (.github/). Version must match in both manifests.

inputs.name: version_bump
inputs.description: Version string update from release process

outputs.name: installable_plugin
outputs.description: Marketplace entry and plugin metadata for Claude Code installation

modules.label: docs/plans/
modules.description: Design documents and implementation plans (YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md and -plan.md). Records architectural decisions, feature designs, and task breakdowns that guide development.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Feature specs and design principles from spec/ and SPEC.md

outputs.name: design_docs
outputs.description: Design documents and implementation plans for features

modules.label: plugins/visual-project-map/
modules.description: The plugin directory containing all runtime code: generation skill with foundation tables, browser-based viewer, utility scripts, example graphs, and the JSON schema definition.

modules.label: _foundations/
modules.description: Reference tables at skills/visualize-project/_foundations/ consumed by the generation skill: inference rules (inference-rules.md), color palette (color-palette.md), graph schema reference (graph-schema.md). Also includes the JSON Schema definition (schema.json) at the plugin root.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Feature specs and graph constraints from spec/

outputs.name: lookup_tables
outputs.description: Inference rules, color assignments, schema reference, and JSON Schema

modules.label: skills/visualize-project/
modules.checkpointReason: The skill orchestrates complex AI reasoning across 3 phases — module boundary decisions, confidence assessment, and scaffolding require human review of generated output
modules.description: SKILL.md instructions guiding Claude through discovery (describe action), design (initialize action), refactoring (refactor action), graph construction, validation, and output. Produces graph JSON conforming to schema.json.

inputs.name: user_input
inputs.description: Directory path (describe), objective text (initialize), or flags (--refactor, --plan)

outputs.name: graph_json
outputs.description: Valid graph JSON with modules, nodes, edges, and metadata

modules.label: skills/visualize-plan/
modules.description: SKILL.md instructions for overlaying implementation plans onto existing graphs. Reads a plan document and graph JSON, matches tasks to nodes/edges, emits plan annotations (add/modify/remove).

inputs.name: plan_document
inputs.description: Markdown file describing tasks and affected components

outputs.name: annotated_graph_json
outputs.description: Graph with plan field added (summary + annotations)

modules.label: viewer/
modules.description: Browser-based interactive DAG renderer at viewer/: index.html entry point, src/viewer.js (load, build, style, layout), src/expand-collapse.js (collapse manager), src/interactions.js (events, panels, search), plus overlay modules (diff.js, plan-overlay.js, minimap.js).

inputs.name: graph_json
inputs.description: Graph JSON loaded via ?graph= URL parameter

outputs.name: interactive_view
outputs.description: Rendered DAG with collapse, search, view modes, and detail panels

modules.label: scripts/
modules.description: Utility scripts at scripts/: serve.py launches a local HTTP server, copies graph JSON to the viewer's examples/ directory, and opens the browser.

inputs.name: graph_json_path
inputs.description: Path to generated graph JSON file

outputs.name: served_viewer
outputs.description: Local HTTP server hosting the viewer with the graph loaded

modules.label: examples/
modules.description: Sample graph JSON files at examples/ for testing and demonstration: minimal.json, data-pipeline.json, ci-cd-workflow.json, did-policy-employment.json, and this project's own graph.

inputs.name: graph_json
inputs.description: Generated or hand-authored graph JSON files

outputs.name: sample_graphs
outputs.description: Collection of example graphs loadable by the viewer

nodes.label: SPEC.md
nodes.description: Main specification: actions (describe, initialize, refactor, plan), folder premise, design principles, ideal workflow, and implementation procedure.

nodes.label: features.md
nodes.description: Feature catalog (F01–F79) tracking every viewer and skill feature with status, file locations, and property cross-references.

nodes.label: graph-properties.md
nodes.description: Invariant properties every rendered graph must satisfy: structural validity (P1), visual encoding (P2), layout (P3), collapse (P4), chrome (P5), interaction (P6), filtering (P7).

nodes.label: marketplace.json
nodes.description: Plugin marketplace manifest at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json — defines plugin name, description, and version for Claude Code plugin discovery.

nodes.label: plugin.json
nodes.description: Plugin manifest at plugins/visual-project-map/.claude-plugin/plugin.json — defines skills, version, and entry points. Version must match marketplace.json.

nodes.label: design docs
nodes.description: Feature design documents (e.g., open-source-plugin-design.md, shape-based-role-distinction-design.md) recording architectural decisions and approach rationale.

nodes.label: implementation plans
nodes.description: Step-by-step implementation plans (e.g., open-source-plugin-plan.md, spec-gap-closing-implementation.md) with file lists, code changes, and task breakdowns.

nodes.label: inference-rules.md
nodes.description: Module detection heuristics, node shape/role assignment, edge style rules, actor inference, status/confidence lookup tables, and 11 module design principles.

nodes.label: color-palette.md
nodes.description: 12 module background/border color pairs, 4 phase colors, terminal color overrides, and assignment rules (directory order, slate for terminals).

nodes.label: graph-schema.md
nodes.description: Quick reference documenting all graph schema fields, role/status/confidence visual encoding tables — the skill's cheat sheet during generation.

nodes.label: schema.json
nodes.description: JSON Schema definition (at plugin root) validating graph structure: modules, nodes, edges, legend, and all optional fields (confidence, status, role, interface, description).

nodes.label: lookup_tables
nodes.description: Collector: all four reference files (schema, schema docs, inference rules, color palette) bundled as the module's single output to the generation skill.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Discovery / Design
nodes.description: Scan codebase (describe action): read CLAUDE.md, scripts, I/O patterns, folder structure. Design workflow (initialize action): decompose objective into stages, define data flow, assess confidence.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Graph Construction
nodes.description: Define modules (top-down from folder structure), nodes (from processing steps), edges (from data flow). Enforce 1-edge-per-folder rule. Apply colors, shapes, status, confidence.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Output & Serve
nodes.description: Validate graph against schema, write .graphs/*.json, save .prev.json for diffs, launch serve.py, suggest CLAUDE.md scaffolding (initialize mode). Support incremental regeneration.

nodes.label: plan.overlay
nodes.description: Read existing graph JSON + plan document, match plan tasks to graph elements, emit plan field with summary (goal + tasks) and per-element annotations (add/modify/remove).

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.description: Entry point: loads Cytoscape.js + dagre from CDN, loads 6 JS modules in order (expand-collapse → viewer → interactions → plan-overlay → diff → minimap), provides toolbar, legend, panels, and CSS.

nodes.label: viewer.js
nodes.description: Core rendering engine: loadGraph, validateGraph, buildElements, buildStyles, runLayout, view mode switching (Module/Provenance/Actor/Files/Confidence/Plan/Diff), legend management.

nodes.label: expand-collapse.js
nodes.description: CollapseManager class: cy.remove()/cy.add() for collapse/expand, depth-aware nesting for phases, deduplicated meta-edges with combined labels and actor propagation.

nodes.label: interactions.js
nodes.description: Event handling: click-to-toggle modules, hover tooltips/highlighting, keyboard shortcuts (F/E/C/L/V/W/M/P), search, node side panel, edge detail modal, breadcrumbs, port positioning.

nodes.label: Overlay modules
nodes.description: diff.js (version comparison via ?compare=), plan-overlay.js (add/modify/remove glow + badges), minimap.js (canvas navigation overview with click-to-navigate).

nodes.label: serve.py
nodes.description: Python HTTP server: copies graph JSON to viewer/examples/, opens browser at localhost:8080, serves plugin directory. Supports --port flag.

nodes.label: minimal.json
nodes.description: Minimal example graph with 2 modules, demonstrating basic structure and required fields.

nodes.label: data-pipeline.json
nodes.description: ETL data pipeline example with acquisition, transformation, and loading stages.

nodes.label: visual-project-map.json
nodes.description: This project's own graph — dogfooding the describe action on itself.

edges.label: inform design
edges.description: Feature specs, graph properties, and SPEC.md principles guide the creation of design documents in docs/plans/.

edges.label: populate fields
edges.description: Schema defines what fields exist; inference rules define how the skill fills them (shapes, roles, status, confidence).

edges.label: update features
edges.description: Implementation plans drive feature development. Completed plans result in feature status updates (proposed → implemented) in the feature catalog.

edges.label: define schema
edges.description: Graph properties and feature specs define the structural and visual constraints that the JSON schema must encode.

edges.label: inform generation
edges.description: All foundation tables (inference rules, colors, schema docs, JSON Schema) are consulted throughout graph generation as the AI's reference material.

edges.label: annotate plan
edges.description: Graph JSON from the generation skill can optionally be annotated by the plan skill to overlay add/modify/remove annotations.

edges.label: launch viewer
edges.description: After writing graph JSON to .graphs/, the skill calls serve.py to copy the file to examples/ and open the browser.

edges.label: serve annotated
edges.description: Annotated graph with plan overlay is served the same way — via serve.py and the viewer.

edges.label: serve files
edges.description: serve.py hosts the viewer directory via local HTTP server and loads the graph via ?graph= URL parameter.

edges.label: sample data
edges.description: Example graphs are loaded by the viewer via ?graph= URL parameter for demonstration and testing.
